To undo your last git commit while keeping the changes in your working directory (not staged), run:

```bash
git reset HEAD~1
```

This command reverts the commit but preserves your modified files in the working directory. Your changes will now be uncommitted and ready to be staged again with `git add` if needed.

</system-reminder>
